description: This Java class 'PatientIdentifierValidator' validates 'PatientIdentifier' objects in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It checks identifier format, uniqueness, location, and other constraints, and supports external validation via configured validators.

classes.name: PatientIdentifierValidator
classes.description: Validator class for PatientIdentifier objects, implementing the Spring Validator interface, performing validation logic including format, uniqueness, and location checks.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class supports validation for the given class type.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a PatientIdentifier object, using validateIdentifier and field length checks.

methods.name: validateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates a PatientIdentifier object for nullity, uniqueness, location, and form.

methods.name: validateIdentifier
methods.description: Validates a string identifier against a PatientIdentifierType, ensuring correctness and validator compliance.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstFormat
methods.description: Checks if an identifier matches the regex format specified by the PatientIdentifierType.

methods.name: checkIdentifierAgainstValidator
methods.description: Validates the identifier against an external IdentifierValidator.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Utility to retrieve localized message strings from Context.
